skill.name: docs-sources
skill.description: Guides AI coding agents through selecting and configuring documentation-source fetch strategies for llms.txt, GitHub raw files, API specs, sitemaps, and browser-rendered sites.
skill.summary: Choose reliable documentation fetch strategies and registry entries for many documentation platforms.
skill.author: Consiliency

security_audit.summary: Static analysis flagged URLs, shell-style examples, markdown backticks, and one checklist line. Review found these detections are documentation examples or formatting, not executable skill code, credential exfiltration, prompt injection, or host reconnaissance. No net-new semantic security findings were identified.

content.value_statement: Documentation ingestion often fails when sites use different frameworks, sitemaps, or JavaScript rendering. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through strategy selection and registry configuration.
actual_capabilities: Checks for llms.txt and llms-full.txt before using broader crawling strategies.
Maps documentation frameworks to GitHub raw fetch patterns and config files.
Selects OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, sitemap, web crawl, or browser crawl strategies.
Provides registry configuration examples for common documentation platforms.
Guides fallback decisions when curl returns incomplete JavaScript-rendered pages.
limitations: Does not fetch documentation by itself; it provides procedures and examples.
Requires the agent or user to verify network requests before running commands.
May need manual updates for new documentation frameworks or custom site structures.
Browser automation steps depend on external tooling and local browser setup.

use_cases.title: Register a New Docs Source
use_cases.description: Choose a fetch strategy and create a registry entry after checking llms.txt, GitHub, API specs, and sitemaps.

use_cases.title: Audit Existing Registry Entries
use_cases.description: Compare current entries against framework signals, source URLs, priorities, and fallback strategies.

use_cases.title: Improve Agent Documentation Retrieval
use_cases.description: Standardize how Claude, Codex, and Claude Code discover high-quality docs before using web crawling.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the docs-sources skill to inspect this documentation URL: [URL]. Recommend the best fetch strategy and explain the required checks.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Registry Entry
prompt_templates.prompt: Use docs-sources to draft a registry entry for [PROJECT] at [URL]. Include strategy, homepage, source paths, and priority.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Fetch Failure
prompt_templates.prompt: Use docs-sources to analyze why curl returns incomplete content for [URL]. Recommend the next fallback and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Source Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use docs-sources to design a complete documentation ingestion plan for [STACK]. Include llms.txt, GitHub raw, API specs, sitemaps, and browser fallback.

output_examples.input: Analyze docs for a React-based project with a public GitHub repo.
output_examples.output: Recommends GitHub raw or Docusaurus detection first, then checks sidebar config and docs paths before any web crawl.

output_examples.input: Add docs for an API service that publishes an OpenAPI file.
output_examples.output: Identifies the OpenAPI strategy, records the spec URL, keeps conceptual docs as a separate source, and recommends validation steps.

output_examples.input: Curl returns a very small HTML shell for a docs page.
output_examples.output: Classifies the site as likely JavaScript-rendered, then recommends browser crawl only after testing llms.txt, GitHub, and sitemap options.

best_practices: Check llms.txt and GitHub raw sources before crawling rendered HTML.
Quote user-provided URLs and review commands before executing network requests.
Validate discovered pages and registry entries after every new source is added.
anti_patterns: Starting with browser automation before testing simpler fetch strategies.
Copying registry examples without replacing placeholder URLs and paths.
Treating sitemap crawls as complete without filtering non-documentation pages.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides instructions and examples. The user or agent decides when to run any command.

faq.question: Which documentation strategies does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers llms.txt, GitHub raw files, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, sitemaps, web crawling, and browser crawling.

faq.question: Can it detect documentation frameworks?
faq.answer: Yes. It lists signals for frameworks such as Docusaurus, MkDocs, Mintlify, Sphinx, Nextra, Starlight, and GitBook.

faq.question: Is this useful for Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It gives repeatable documentation-source checks that Claude Code, Codex, and similar agents can follow.

faq.question: Does it replace manual verification?
faq.answer: No. Users should still verify fetched pages, registry entries, and command output before relying on the results.

faq.question: When should browser crawling be used?
faq.answer: Use browser crawling only after simpler sources fail or when a site clearly requires JavaScript rendering.
